title: Philip II to Don Juan of Austria, Madrid, 28 Aug 1574 (KHA G016-A0204)

steps.what: Fetched the 6 KHA scans at full size through the Koninklijke Verzamelingen rendition API.
Gachard (Netherlands correspondence, Don Juan from 1576), web search for Esquivia, DECODE dump: no printed or online reading.
Found a clear version of the cipher letter on a separate sheet in the same item (alférez Diego de Esquivia, captive 1558-73).
Aligned the cipher on scan 1 word by word with the clear version and rebuilt the letter table, the vowel marks (cross e, dot i, stroke u) and code groups pe/co/Lo (key.md).
Read ~14 of ~30 cipher lines with the key against the clear version: all agree except hazer/saber at the end of paragraph 1 and the name Oram bey (Hürrem Bey) the decipherer left unclear.

outcome.method_basis: The item carries a clear version of the cipher on a separate sheet; the key was rebuilt from that pair and confirms it on the lines checked.

texts.label: Philip II to Don Juan of Austria, Madrid, 28 Aug 1574 (KHA G016-A0204)
texts.summary: Philip II recommends the alférez Diego de Esquivia, a former captive of Hasan Pasha, to serve near Don Juan at 15 escudos a month, and sends through him answers to Hürrem Bey, the Sultan's chief interpreter, and to Mostafa, a Milanese renegade engineer with Uluç Ali's fleet, both encouraged to keep serving Spain.

reading_review.note: The clear version reads as continuous Spanish; checked against the cipher with the rebuilt key on ~14 lines. Not checked by a person.

outcome.notes: Read from the clear sheet in the same item; key rebuilt and checked on sampled lines.
